{{Vanilla|Painting|Paintings}}
'''Paintings''' work as in vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds no new paintings, but its resource pack changes two textures.

== Changes ==
* The back of every painting is retextured with a darker wooden frame, which the release notes call spruce.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/textures/painting/back.png}}</ref><ref>{{Cite changelog|0.6-alpha|quote=Paintings have spruce as frame colour.}}</ref>
* Kristoffer Zetterstrand's ''Match'' painting has a darker, less saturated frame. The picture inside the frame is unchanged.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/textures/painting/match.png}}</ref><ref>{{Cite changelog|0.6-alpha|quote=I changed Zetterstrand's Match to have a darker, less saturated frame}}</ref>

{{Planned|source=changelog.md}}
The in-development changelog lists "New paintings (with hints!)" among community suggestions for later updates.<ref>{{Source|changelog.md}}</ref>
